title: Master Rim's Taekwondo

services.name: Airdrie Taekwondo
services.desc: At Master Rim’s Taekwondo in Calgary, Red Deer and Airdrie, we create a fun, memorable class and use positive feedback to make sure your child builds a strong foundation of self-discipline, self-esteem and respect that can be transferred to his or her academics, sports and social activities. While your kids are getting a great workout that they just can’t get with any other physical activity, they’ll be building rock-solid self-defense skills that will strengthen their confidence and prepare them for anything life throws their way. Bring out the best in your children with the help of Master Rim’s TaeKwonDo
